title: Edit MP3 coded gain without changing spectral payload

definition.title: Edit MP3 coded gain without changing spectral payload
definition.source_excerpt: For a bounded MPEG-1 Layer III mono/no-CRC profile, every granule's global_gain was reduced by four steps while main-data/spectral payload hashes were left unchanged. Host decoded RMS became 0.500000004× the original (target 0.5); the maximum sample error versus half-amplitude was 5.31e-08. Chromium measured 0.499999757× after decoding at 48 kHz. Underflow is explicitly rejected and an MPEG-2 fixture fails this narrow admission profile instead of being patched with the wrong side-information layout. Output is intentionally changed; this is not bit-exact editing.
